channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Na Expointer, Flávio Bolsonaro se reúne com agronegócio do Rio Grande do Sul
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate, met with Rio Grande do Sul agribusiness leaders at Expointer, an agricultural fair in Porto Alegre. The meeting took place at a restaurant in the Assis Brasil Exhibition Park.

item.title: Caiado, sobre Flávio Bolsonaro no caso Master: Não dá pra passar pano
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Flávio Bolsonaro over new payments from the Master Bank, stating that one cannot 'turn a blind eye' to the case. The episode reinforces debates on corruption and private interests in politics.

item.title: TSE manda Eduardo Bolsonaro excluir conteúdos falsos sobre urnas
item.description: The TSE ordered Eduardo Bolsonaro to remove YouTube content questioning the security of electronic voting machines, deeming it false. The decision was made by Minister Nunes Marques, president of the court.

item.title: TSE chama deepfake de deepfake, mas cria exceção e poupa Flávio
item.description: The TSE defines deepfake as fraudulent content, but creates an exception by not punishing Senator Flávio Doutorio for image editing in campaign. The decision generates controversy over selective application of electoral rules.

item.title: 6x1: oposição pede vista e presidente da CCJ dá 1h para análise
item.description: The president of the Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee, Otto Alencar, granted one hour of review time for the PEC reducing the workday from 44 to 40 hours, following pressure from the opposition led by Rogério Marinho. During the session, rapporteur Omar Aziz defended the proposal's admissibility and rejected 35 amendments, while debates arose over deadlines and legislative priorities. The vote is scheduled for Wednesday, amid labor issues as a government priority for Lula.

item.title: Caso de Bolsonaro faz TSE fixar critérios para deepfake; entenda
item.description: The TSE established criteria to identify deepfakes in the 2026 elections while ruling on a lawsuit against Flávio Bolsonaro for using an AI-generated video featuring Jair Bolsonaro. By 5-2, it defined deepfake as AI-synthesized content with high realism, but sanctions require classification as electoral propaganda. The court rejected fines against Flávio and ruled that displaying a video at an online party convention does not automatically constitute early campaigning.

item.title: As duas ‘batatas quentes’ que colocam André Mendonça no centro da eleição
item.description: The investigations involving INSS and Banco Master bring Justice Minister André Mendonça to the center of political tensions. His judicial decisions may influence key figures such as Fábio Lulinha and Flávio Bolsonaro, increasing electoral polarization. Additionally, public information related to Minister Alexandre de Moraes creates internal tensions within the STF.

item.title: Fim da 6x1: relator lê parecer; presidente da CCJ concede vista de uma hora após pedido da oposição
item.description: The Senate's Constitution and Justice Commission approved the report ending the 6x1 work schedule, granting one hour of review time by President Otto Alencar following opposition pressure. The constitutional amendment sets a reduction from 44 to 40 weekly working hours within 14 months, preserving two rest days, but introduces no major amendments to the version approved by the Chamber.

item.title: PEC do fim da 6 x 1: senador Rogério Marinho, coordenador da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro, pede vista
item.description: During the discussion at the Senate Committee on Constitution and Justice (CCJ) regarding the Constitutional Amendment Proposal (PEC) that seeks to end the 6x1 scale, Senator Rogério Marinho, campaign manager for Flávio Bolsonaro, requested 'vista' on the project. This request aims to delay the PEC's progress and prevent the issue from reaching the Senate floor, representing a strategy used by the opposition to block or slow down the proposal's passage.

item.title: "Não é possível passar pano", diz Caiado sobre Flávio e Moraes
item.description: Caiado criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro and Moraes for not clarifying the controversy involving money from the Dark Horse film and conversations with Daniel Vorcaro, stating the situation cannot be treated as a blank page and requesting the immediate removal of Moraes from the STF due to alleged complicity.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest: Lula perde força e eleição de 2026 fica mais aberta
item.description: The Quaest poll shows Lula's approval dropping to 45% with 48% disapproval, pointing to a more open 2026 race. The president faces adverse media coverage and family scandals, yet still holds a slight edge over Flávio Bolsonaro in rejection ratings (55% to 53%). Supreme Court crisis and weak economic performance also weigh negatively on the incumbent.

item.title: Relatório Vorcaro-Moraes sai 2ª ou 3ª, e Fachin fará sessão semana que vem
item.description: The report by Minister André Mendonça regarding the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes in the Banco Master case is expected to be delivered on Tuesday or Wednesday, with a Supreme Court plenary session scheduled for next week, including live broadcast for transparency. The Court is divided between ministers supporting and opposing the investigation, with Carmen Lúcia as the deciding vote in case of a tie. The vote takes place amid pressure from right-wing protests on Independence Day.

item.title: Ao vivo: STF julga tributação de reservas das seguradoras
item.description: The STF resumes plenary sessions, reviewing the constitutionality of PIS/Cofins taxation on insurance companies' technical reserves. The session also marks the first participation of Minister Alexandre de Moraes following the disclosure of messages exchanged with Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro, within the scope of PF investigations.

item.title: Campanhas coordenadas de desinformação ameaçam as eleições
item.description: Coordinated disinformation campaigns use techniques like 'firehosing' and 'bot farms' to manipulate public opinion in the 2026 elections, without an adequate response from the Electoral Justice. Brazil has become a disinformation laboratory since 2018, with attacks on institutions and the political system. The intensification of the fight against disinformation by the STF and Minister Alexandre de Moraes has faced these actions, but the threat persists.

item.title: Nunes Marques mantém peça de campanha de Lula que associa Flávio Bolsonaro ao Master
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's request to suspend Lula's campaign ad linking him to the Master scandal, deeming it legitimate political criticism. The ad uses edited clips of the senator, but Nunes Marques found no grave manipulation or factual falsehood. He also dismissed a PT lawsuit against the dissemination of Jair Bolsonaro's 'Letter to Brazilians,' ruling it was not early electoral propaganda.

item.title: STF está dividido e Carmen Lúcia será voto de minerva sobre Moraes
item.description: The STF is split over the investigation of Moraes in the Master case, with 4 justices in favor and 3 against. Carmen Lúcia holds the deciding vote, potentially breaking a tie. A session is scheduled next week amid pressure from right-wing demonstrations on September 2nd.

item.title: Câmara confirma indicação de Rodrigo Pacheco ao TCU
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved Rodrigo Pacheco's (PSB-MG) nomination to the Tribunal of Accounts (TCU) with 407 votes, following Bruno Dantas' resignation. The Senate also approved the nomination with 63 votes, with the swearing-in expected after October elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro reduz vantagem de Lula, mostra Agregador Carta/Colectta
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has narrowed the gap with President Lula (PT) in voter intentions, according to the Carta/Collective Aggregator, showing the PT candidate with a 4.9 percentage point lead in the first round and only 1 point in the second round. The rise of Augusto Cury (Avante) was also highlighted, surpassing other third-way candidates. The aggregator considers all surveys registered with the TSE for more precise projections.

item.title: Câmara e Senado aprovam a indicação de Rodrigo Pacheco ao TCU
item.description: Both the Chamber of Deputies and the Federal Senate approved Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB-MG) as a minister of the Tribunal de Contas da União (TCU), filling the vacancy left by Bruno Dantas, who resigned. Pacheco, a former Senate president, secured 404 votes in favor in the Chamber and 63 in the Senate, with leaders praising his technical and political qualifications. The nomination now moves to Congress for final approval.

item.title: Master: Oposição pede a Lula exoneração imediata de Paulo Gonet
item.description: Opposition leaders requested the immediate removal of Paulo Gonet, Attorney General of the Republic, over alleged conflicts of interest with banker Daniel Vorcaro from Banco Master. They accuse Gonet of maintaining a close personal relationship with Vorcaro and filed a criminal complaint and impeachment requests. The case is under review at the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Quaest: 44% acham que Flávio não é mais moderado que a família Bolsonaro
item.description: Quaest survey shows that 44% of voters believe Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is not more moderate than his family, while 37% see him as more moderate; 19% did not answer. Perception of Lula (PT) was also measured: 42% say the president is more moderate than the party, versus 39%. Second-round voting intention reveals a technical tie between the two leaders. Methodology: 2,004 interviews, margin of error ±2 points, registered with the TSE.

item.title: Mendonça confirma depoimento de Vorcaro sem PF e diz que Moraes não foi tema do encontro
item.description: STF Minister André Mendonça confirmed that former banker Daniel Vorcaro gave a testimony without the presence of the Federal Police, but with the participation of the Public Prosecutor's Office. Mendonça emphasized that the meeting did not address Minister Alexandre Moraes as a topic.

item.title: Caiado critica Moraes por novos desdobramentos do Master: 'fora de qualquer limite aceitável'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) publicly criticized Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes over alleged developments involving Banco Master and businessman Daniel Vorcaro, stating that the minister's actions are 'beyond any acceptable limit'. The statement was made within the context of the 2026 presidential campaign.

item.title: Influenciadores investigados no caso Master contribuíram para a escalada digital de Cury
item.description: Influencers investigated in the Banco Master scandal were used to artificially boost Augusto Cury's social media presence, helping raise his poll numbers from 2% to 11% in one week.

item.title: Crise no STF ajuda Lula a esfriar escândalo sobre tráfico de influência de Lulinha
item.description: The crisis at the STF involving Alexandre de Moraes and the scandal over alleged influence peddling by Lulinha helped shift focus away from Lula's campaign, which is facing criticism after a controversial interview. Leaked messages between Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro intensified the turmoil at the Supreme Court, indirectly benefiting the PT candidate, though he may also face backlash due to his closeness to the minister.

item.title: Caiado quer PEC de até 3 anos para conter gastos obrigatórios
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado proposes an emergency fiscal PEC to limit mandatory spending for 2 to 3 years, prioritizing adjustments to pensions, social transfers, and income programs. The measure aims to balance the economy and reduce debt, maintaining pension adjustments at least by inflation.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula no RJ: empatados em todos os cenários e também em rejeição
item.description: New survey from Rio de Janeiro shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula in both rounds (36% to 34% in the first, 45% to 41% in the second), with high rejection rates (50% and 49%). Writer Augusto Cury ranks third in voter intent.

item.title: Mendonça diz que esteve com Vorcaro uma vez e que “se limitou a ouvi-lo”
item.description: Supreme Court minister André Mendonça stated in a note that he met Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master, once in March 2025, and only listened to him regarding STP 976. The meeting was arranged through messages with congressman Cezinha de Madureira.

item.title: Paula Lavigne reclama de plateias vazias em shows e pede ajuda de Lula
item.description: In a meeting with Lula, Paula Lavigne highlighted the crisis in the Brazilian cultural sector, linking the decline in concert attendance to the rise of online betting and public funding for sertanejo events. She demanded reforms to the Lei Rouanet and criticized former President Temer for destabilizing the country.

item.title: Ex-ministros do governo cobram apuração sobre Moraes enquanto Lula silencia
item.description: Former Lula government ministers distance themselves from Alexandre de Moraes following the scandal involving leaked messages with Daniel Vorcaro, while Lula remains silent fearing harm to his polling numbers. Figures such as Simone Tebet, Fernando Haddad, Gleisi Hoffmann, and Paulo Pimenta advocate for investigations and the rule of law to apply to everyone, including Supreme Court justices.

item.title: JOTA Principal | Guerra entre Mendonça e Moraes pelo Master extravasa à campanha presidencial
item.description: The dispute between justices Edson Fachin and Alexandre de Moraes over control of the 'Master' legal operation has spilled into the 2026 presidential campaign, amid allegations involving Moraes' contracts and political alliances. The investigation exposes connections between figures like Geraldo Alckmin, Gilberto Kassab, and the R$131 million contract linked to Moraes' wife.

item.title: A avaliação de Nunes Marque sobre carta de Bolsonaro lida por Flávio
item.description: The president of the TSE, Nunes Marques, rejected the PT's request to remove the video in which Flávio Bolsonaro read a letter of support from Jair Bolsonaro. He ruled there was no early electoral propaganda or call for voters not to vote, denying the injunction. The case will be analyzed by the TSE plenary and was also discussed at the STF, where Moraes suspended Bolsonaro's visits, deeming he should not disseminate political statements.

item.title: Realtime: Douglas Ruas cresce 5 pontos; Garotinho derrete
item.description: Pesquisa Realtime Big Data shows Douglas Ruas (PL) rising from 16% to 21% in gubernatorial intentions in Rio de Janeiro between July and September. Backed by Flávio Bolsonaro, Ruas leads growth in the state race. Meanwhile, Garotinho experiences a significant decline in the same poll.

item.title: Flamengo tenta manter invencibilidade diante do Mirassol; veja odds
item.description: Flamengo faces Mirassol at Maracanã Stadium in the fourth round of the Brazilian Championship, aiming to maintain its undefeated streak. With favorable odds (1.23 for Flamengo victory), the matchup shows historical performance with wins and draws between the teams. The red-black attack leads the championship with 48 goals scored.

item.title: "Escândalo": imprensa internacional repercute relação de Vorcaro e Moraes
item.description: Messages exchanged between detained banker Daniel Vorcaro and Minister Alexandre de Moraes sparked international media coverage, described as a 'political and institutional earthquake' by Argentine newspaper La Nación. The interactions suggest Vorcaro may have sought advice from Moraes about fleeing the country before his arrest by federal police.

item.title: Agenda dos candidatos: Lula cumpre compromissos no Planalto enquanto Flávio Bolsonaro vai ao Rio Grande do Sul
item.description: President Lula (PT) follows institutional agenda at Planalto, sanctions a cardiovascular emergency bill and holds official meetings. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) focuses campaign in Rio Grande do Sul, attending Expointer and a rally in Porto Alegre. Other candidates have scattered agendas in São Paulo, Brasília and other regions.

item.title: Moraes não é o STF
item.description: The article questions the view that the STF was essential for democracy in Brazil, especially during Bolsonaro's government. It highlights the chaos and threats made by Bolsonaro to institutions, but also suggests that this historical interpretation should be reconsidered. The focus reinforces the importance of understanding the role of institutions without idealizations.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta quarta-feira (2)
item.description: On Wednesday's agenda, presidential candidates hold interviews, debates, institutional visits, and market tours, along with walks and party events. Most maintain public activities, while some candidates have not yet released their schedules. Coverage follows a daily alphabetical rotation.

item.title: Mendonça admite ter recebido Vorcaro em instituto em SP, mas diz que não tratou de Master e BC
item.description: Minister André Mendonça, rapporteur of the Banco Master case at the STF, acknowledged receiving banker Daniel Vorcaro at an educational institution in São Paulo but denied discussing Central Bank matters. The meeting, arranged by political intermediaries, reportedly focused on a legal agenda regarding a Temporary Injunction Suspension, even as investigations into Banco Master were already underway.

item.title: Lula terá termômetro real de chance de promessas de Alcolumbre serem entregues
item.description: President Lula will soon receive an assessment on the feasibility of promises made by Davi Alcolumbre, including the advancement of PECs in the Senate CCJ. The opposition will attempt to hinder the progress of these measures, which may benefit Lula in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Pesquisa Real Time Big Data indica empate entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula no RJ
item.description: A poll conducted by Real Time Big Data in Rio de Janeiro between August 28 and September 1, with 2,000 voters, shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) in both the first round (36% vs 34%) and the second round (45% vs 41%), within the two percentage point margin of error.

item.title: Mensagens indicam encontro entre Vorcaro e André Mendonça em São Paulo
item.description: Leaked messages reveal a secret meeting between banker Daniel Vorcaro and Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça in March 2025, arranged by lawyer Ciro Rocha Soares and federal deputy Cezinha de Madureira. The meeting, lasting about two hours at the ITER Institute, was acknowledged by Mendonça, though he denied discussing Banco Master matters with the Central Bank. Meanwhile, PF documents exposed communication between Vorcaro and Justice Alexandre de Moraes, indicating the banker's concerns over ongoing investigations.

item.title: Quais crimes podem ser investigados e quem pode processar e julgar um ministro do STF? Entenda
item.description: The PGR requested the nullification of the PF report regarding minister Alexandre de Moraes, challenging the legality of the investigations ordered by another minister, André Mendonça. The discussion at the STF is analyzing whether the investigation can proceed and if the evidence is valid, prior to any potential criminal proceeding against Moraes. Depending on the nature of the attributed crime, the STF or the Federal Senate would have jurisdiction to judge.

item.title: Empresários e banqueiros pedem estabilidade a Lula e se queixam de juros altos
item.description: Business leaders and bankers invited to dinner at the Alvorada Palace requested economic and institutional stability from President Lula, expressing concern about high interest rates. The meeting took place Monday night in Brasília. Guests emphasized the importance of policies ensuring legal certainty for the business sector.

item.title: "Somos mais conservadores": Felipe Nunes, fundador do Quaest, analisa avanço da direita no Brasil
item.description: Felipe Nunes, founder of the Quaest institute, states that Brazilian society has become more conservative and right-wing, with self-declared right-wing identification rising from 20% in 2002 to about 35% today. He attributes this shift to increased political awareness and ideological alignment among citizens, reducing the number of people who claim no political definition. He also introduces his book 'Brasil no Espelho', which analyzes the current profile of Brazilians.

item.title: Bolsonaristas avisam governo Trump sobre mensagens entre Vorcaro e Moraes
item.description: Leaked PF messages reveal contacts between Minister Alexandre de Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro, including meetings at the minister's apartment and an alleged attempt to help Vorcaro flee the country before his arrest. Bolsonaro allies shared the material with Trump administration figures to push for renewed Magnitsky Act sanctions against Moraes. Flávio Bolsonaro leads a move to create a congressional inquiry into the minister's ties to Vorcaro.

item.title: Copa do Brasil: Palmeiras eliminou Santos em todos os duelos da competição
item.description: Palmeiras faces Santos in the Copa do Brasil second leg, defending a 3-0 first-leg advantage. All previous meetings between the teams in the competition ended with Palmeiras advancing.

item.title: Lula avalia medida anti-bets para antes das eleições; veja detalhes
item.description: President Lula is considering implementing measures against online betting before the October elections, targeting platforms such as Jogo do Tigrinho. The initiative, still under evaluation, could include advertising restrictions or stricter actions using provisional measures or judicial initiatives.

item.title: Funks clássicos viram aposta de candidatos na corrida presidencial de 2026
item.description: In the 2026 presidential race, candidates use 1990s funk classics to engage voters. 'Rap da Felicidade' is adopted by Augusto Cury (Avante), while 'Rap do Silva' supports Lula's (PT) re-election. This strategy aims to connect with voters from peripheries and large urban centers.

item.title: As mensagens de Vorcaro a Moraes e o futuro do Caso Master no Supremo - O Assunto #1796
item.description: Justice André Mendonça released a sealed Federal Police report suggesting messaging between Daniel Vorcaro and Alexandre de Moraes prior to the Banco Master arrest, hinting at potential protection. The report also claims Moraes may have edited a contract between his wife's law firm and Vorcaro, and that a $1.6 million payment to the film Dark Horse followed public pressure from Flávio Bolsonaro. Mendonça requested clarification from the Attorney General's office and proposed the case return to the STF plenary.
